source.design: rd_newdir D4 (PREREG §1 D4 + common leverage rule §0) re-evaluated in rd_regime as D4_N200_tv60

clock.daily_bar: spot 1d kline of UTC date d (00:00–24:00 UTC)
clock.decision_time: close of perp 1h bar 23:00 UTC of day d (= 00:00 UTC d+1)
clock.fill: open of perp 1h bar 00:00 UTC d+1 (market, taker)
clock.decision_frequency: once per day; no intraday decisions

signal.formula: sig_i(d) = 1 if S_i(d) > SMA200_i(d) else 0, S=spot daily close of day d, SMA200_i(d)=mean(S_i(d-199..d)) (includes day d, needs 200 closes; else 0)
signal.prev_close_usage: uses day d's own just-completed close (no extra one-day lag); trades at the very next 1h open

asset_weight_1x.sigma20: std(ln S_i(k)/S_i(k-1), k=d-19..d, ddof=1, min 15 obs) * sqrt(365); NaN -> w=0
asset_weight_1x.allocation: BTC and ETH each a 0.5 sleeve (fixed), each scaled down only (cap 1) by its own 60%-vol ratio; no cross-rebalancing; total 1x gross <= 1

account_leverage.cap_note: tested cap is 3x (rd_newdir PREREG: 'Lcap=5（D4 用 3）'; rd_regime run.py ('common',0.6,3.0)). NOT 5x. Account gross limit 5x and per-position |w|<=3 are additional clips that never bind.
account_leverage.formula: L(d) = min(3, 0.60 / max(sigma60_1x(d), 0.05)); L=1 while fewer than 20 daily returns
account_leverage.sigma60_1x: std of last 60 daily returns (ddof=1, min 20) of the SHADOW 1x book equity (closes of 23:00 UTC perp bar), * sqrt(365); first return = E1x(2020-06-24)/10000-1
account_leverage.shadow_1x_book: a separate paper book trading w1x with the identical engine (band, fees, funding) — its equity drives L. Must be persisted and continued (seed from bars.csv.gz last row: BTC_units_1x_shadow, ETH_units_1x_shadow, equity_1x_shadow).
account_leverage.target_weight: w_i(d) = w1x_i(d) * L(d); clip |w_i|<=3; if sum|w|>5 scale to 5 (never binds; max per coin 1.5, max gross 3)

rebalance.when: only at the daily fill (00:00 UTC open)
rebalance.rule: V = cash + sum(units*Open); wc = units*Open/V. Trade symbol i iff (wt==0 and units!=0) [exit_to_cash] or (wc==0 and wt!=0) [entry] or sign differs [flip, never occurs] or |wt-wc| > 0.25*|wt| [rebalance_band]. If trading: units := wt*V/Open (exactly to target).
rebalance.sizing_reference_equity: V at fill-bar open after that bar's funding

costs.slippage: included in the 20bps; fill price = 1h open

funding.source: Binance USDT-M historical fundingRate (2026-10-01..10-10 estimated from premium index)
funding.rule: at the bar whose OPEN is a settlement time (BTC/ETH 00/08/16 UTC): cash -= units * Open * rate; applied BEFORE that bar's fills (so the 00:00 settlement is paid on the position held before the daily trade)

margin.type: CROSS (single cross-margined USDT account holding both perps; NOT isolated)
margin.liquidation_check: every 1h bar after fills: worst = cash + sum(units*Low) (longs); gw = sum(|units|*Low); if worst <= 0.005*gw -> close all at worst minus 20bps

stops: none (no stop-loss, no take-profit, no time stop). Exit only when spot close <= SMA200 (or sigma20 NaN).

gates.neighbor_note: N50/N100 (same tv) have MaxDD -75%..-85% (2022 whipsaw); N200 is a non-default (★ was N100) pre-registered value => mild selection bias. Honest yearly WF (pick N by past Sharpe) CAGR 20.5% full / 74.0% 3y.

parity_fixture.bars: bars.csv.gz (1h, 2020-06-24..2026-10-10 23:00 UTC, BTC/ETH OHLC, funding, state weights, units, indicators used, L, equities)
parity_fixture.tolerance_hint: replica of engine verified exact (rtol 1e-9). Live runner will differ by qty rounding (stepSize 0.001) and real fill vs 1h open.
